messages:
ops-bot: Alert: elevated LB client retries observed for inter-region flows. Automated detector links spikes to recent DNS propagation event.
emily-r: Noticing ~3x retry rate from ap-south->eu-west starting 03:22 UTC. Errors are TLS handshake failures during resume; backend healthy otherwise.
raj-p: I see a concurrent DNS SOA bump from our registrar at 03:18 for api.redwood.example, TTL changed to 60s for a test. Possible propagation causing route rebinds.
nina-b: Quick repro from ap-south probe -> eu-west LB: curl returns 502 and TLS handshake unexpected_message. snippet:
```
$ curl -sS -I https://api.redwood.example/health --resolve api.redwood.example:443:3.5.67.12
HTTP/2 502\n* TLSv1.3 alert (unexpected_message)\n
```
sylvia-l: Action list — keep items minimal and assigned here: 
- Action A (NET-5120): Revert TTL experiment and restore standard 300s TTL. Owner: @raj-p. ETA: 30m.
- Action B (NET-5121): Deploy short-lived probe "dns-propagation-canary" that runs cross-region TLS resume/resend checks. Owner: @nina-b. ETA: 24h. Alert if retry-rate >2x baseline.
- Action C (NET-5122): Add a control-plane guard to pause route rebinds for 5s after DNS-originated updates to avoid apply-thundering. Owner: @sylvia-l. ETA: 5d.
- Action D (NET-5123): Short-term mitigation: apply client-side exponential backoff multiplier for cross-region retries. Owner: @emily-r. ETA: 1h.
emily-r: I'm pushing the backoff override now to 25% traffic to reduce amplification, will ramp if stable.
raj-p: Reverted TTL to 300s; DNS propagation in progress. ops-bot: DNS TTL restored to 300.
nina-b: Canary scheduled in canary pool; initial baseline shows 1.6x, will escalate if passes 2.
sylvia-l: I'll draft RFC for route-apply guard (NET-5122) and include a knob to opt-out for emergency rolls.
emily-r: Observability item: add "dns_event_id" tag to route-sync logs and a metric tls_resume_retry_rate tagged by rollout_id and dns_event. Owner: @emily-r. ETA: 72h.
raj-p: Noting recurrence: similar chain seen last quarter where short TTLs + rapid route updates triggered retry storms. Recommend monthly retention of recent rollout+dns-change events for pattern detection. Owner: @sylvia-l. ETA: 2w.
sylvia-l: Scheduling a 30-min follow-up tomorrow 09:00 UTC to walk NET-5120..5123 and assign postmortem writer. Please add any observations to NET-5120.
ops-bot: Incident update: mitigation in progress (TTL restored, partial backoff deployed). Monitoring window open for 60 minutes. Severity: Sev2. Further updates will be appended to this thread.
